name: Bio-Etheric Veils (Akashic)
body:
Prerequisites(s): Con 13, 3rd-level veilweaver.

Benefit(s): When you gain the dying condition, as a free action that can be taken on your turn even if you are unconscious, you can select one of your shaped veils. The selected veil is destroyed and you automatically stabilize.

You take essence burn equal to the amount of essence invested in the destroyed veil and gain 1 hit point for each point of essence burn taken in this way. Additionally, when a veil you have shaped would take enough damage to be sundered, you can use an immediate action to instead take some or all of the damage yourself to prevent this. Damage taken in this way is not reduced by damage reduction or energy resistance, immunity and cannot be prevented or redirected further in any way.

You gain 1 point of essence.
